function.name: search_dossiers
function.description: Find living topic dossiers (per-country, per-person, or pair relations). Use for any 'what is going on with X' or 'relations between A and B' question. Not limited to wars.

function.name: search_events
function.description: Search dated events (elections, taxes, inflation, protests, wars, disasters, appointments, court cases, ...). Filter by entity names and date range.

function.name: get_timeline
function.description: Ordered timeline for one or more named entities. This is the right tool for 'what happened in country A between 2026 and 2028'.

function.name: get_background
function.description: Assemble background for a why/how question about a country, person, or conflict. Pulls the entity dossier, recent office-holders (president, PM, ...), and several years of politics/economy/conflict events. Use this for questions like 'why did country A oust its president' or 'context of the conflict between A and B'.

function.name: get_article
function.description: Fetch one source article by id (from a dossier timeline or event).

function.name: resolve_entity
function.description: Look up a name (country, person, org, city) in the knowledge base, including aliases.
